title: Hit a midlife wall? This test identifies your strengths and what matters to you
content: As part of her new podcast and newsletter Your Turn with Allison Aubrey, NPR's Allison Aubrey went in search of tools to help navigate midlife — starting with this survey to rank one's character strengths.

title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
content: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
content: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
content: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
content: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

title: After booting 760K off ACA health plans, the Trump administration adds some people back
content: The Trump administration provided few details about its process for canceling hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments — even as the next stage of the anti-fraud effort is underway.

title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
content: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

title: Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training
content: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

title: Make a 'sick day' kit for cold and flu season before your household gets hit
content: Cold and flu season is here. Before someone in your household gets hit, make sure you have these essential meds and comfort items in your medicine cabinet.

title: These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices
content: Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day.
